codes.meaning: The dishwasher failed to drain properly — a clogged air gap, kinked drain hose, missing disposer knockout plug, or the unit not sitting level.
The dishwasher took too long to fill, typically a closed supply valve, pinched fill line, or low water pressure.
The water-level sensor detected less water than it should, often from a tipped dish trapping water.
The water-level sensor detected more water than expected, usually from rack items blocking the sensor.
The sensor that monitors wash-water temperature is not sending a valid reading.
The control board isn't receiving the expected response from the drain pump.
The temperature sensor circuit is reading as an open circuit, meaning the sensor or its wiring has lost continuity.
The temperature sensor circuit is reading as shorted.
A freezer or refrigerator door/drawer has been left ajar for more than three minutes.
The compartment has stayed above its safe temperature threshold for roughly two hours.
The unit detected it lost power at some point and keeps a flashing indicator lit until manually cleared.
Either the fresh-food or freezer compartment has exceeded its maximum allowed temperature.
The water filter cartridge has reached the end of its rated life.
A door or drawer has been left open for more than three minutes.
The unit recognizes it went without electricity for an extended period.
The UV bulb used in the odor/mold-reduction air-purification feature has reached the end of its service life.
The condenser coils are due for cleaning, shown as a blinking indicator.
